description.p: Varco holds every new network connection, outgoing or incoming, until you allow or block it. For each request it shows which program asks, where it wants to go, and who is on the other side.

Varco trattiene ogni nuova connessione di rete, in uscita o in entrata, finché non la consenti o la blocchi. Per ogni richiesta mostra quale programma la chiede, dove vuole andare e chi c'è dall'altra parte.

ul.li: Decisions from desktop notifications, permanent rules
Kill switch that isolates the computer
Watchdog that reports new and suspicious programs
Optional privacy module: random MAC address, generic name, hidden serial numbers

description.p: Harder to get around: DNS only towards the computer's DNS servers, names learned only from them, programs started with extra options, variables or shared connections are no longer taken for approved ones. More private by default: no whois, no reverse DNS, no history of allowed connections in the journal, computer name not sent to the router.
Pre-existing configuration files are restored exactly; hardware masking is verified.
Fail-closed in real failure conditions, kill switch on every network including virtual machines, network type in requests and rules, safe and verified restore of identifiers.
